title: Maurice Durand and Carnival parade work with the Buzzards
summary: The interviewer discusses Maurice Durand and the Arabian Packing Company parade; Glass says he played with the Buzzards for years.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: You played with him a long time, Nero? Yeah, I played Maurice Durand down there a long time. Maurice and all that? And he was the bass player and I was playing with the Olympia Suriners and all the pass. I remember he did that, and it all, but he didn't. Cam Wright started playing bass again. But he's dead now. Oh yeah. He's got a son just like him. What did Maurice Durand do on Carnival? Now you tell me about that. On Carnival we used to play the Arabian Packing Company parade. From the Seminart, right down there.
From the Seminart, right down there.
From the Seminart. The Seminart's pass. It's sad, but it's still going on. Yeah, they have that parade. Did you ever play it? No, I never played. You must have been with the Buzzards, huh?
Oh, I've been with the Buzzards for years. They tried to get me to go back now. I don't know, I might go with the Buzzards next year if Harold don't have nothing. I ain't going to be there.
He ain't going to be there?
I'm not going to be there.
